subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main WSL2 or Docker reproduction of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's updated hypothesis, but global session routing is compatibility-sensitive and the issue is already labeled for maintainer review and live reproduction.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a focused fix with regression coverage for that confirmed path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence as sufficient and let a repair PR attempt a narrow heartbeat/session resolver fix plus tests without live proof first.

options.title: Fold into session routing review
options.body: Keep the issue open but handle it together with adjacent global-session and dmScope routing decisions.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a focused fix with regression coverage for that confirmed path.
